js: const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('.detail-meta__part, .detail-traits > span')]; const R=document.createRange(); const box=e=>{R.selectNodeContents(e); return R.getBoundingClientRect()}; let overlap=0; for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++){const a=box(p[i-1]),b=box(p[i]); if(Math.abs(a.top-b.top)<4 && b.left<a.right+3) overlap++;} return {parts:p.length, overlap, text:document.querySelector('.detail-meta').textContent}
